description: OV haltes Den Haag is a dataset listed in den-haag-opendata open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by den-haag-opendata. Beschrijving: De OV-halte kaart is een samengesteld product van leveringen van diverse exploitanten die in de gemeente Den Haag opereren. De brondata is afkomstig van het NDOV loket en vervolgens bewerkt door DSO/PSO van de gemeente Den Haag. Coverage: The Hague. The portal files it under Traffic. The portal shows 1,593 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-05-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-den-haag-opendata-portal.
